```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = F, warning = F, error = F, fig.align = "center", collapse = T,
                      cache = T)
```

```{r libraries}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

# DOC data

```{r read-data}
doc <- read_xlsx("TOC_cv.xlsx")
```

```{r model-cv}
cv_lm <- lm(CV~Mean_TOC, data = subset(doc, CV > 0)) %>% summary()

print(cv_lm)

cv_fit <- nls(
  CV ~ a*Mean_TOC^b,
  data = subset(doc, CV >0),
  start = list(a = coef(cv_lm)[[2]], b = coef(cv_lm)[[1]]), # on utilise les valeurs de pocfit comme coefficients initiaux
)

summary(cv_fit) %>% print()

doc$cv_fitted <- predict(cv_fit,doc)

ggplot(doc, aes(x = Mean_TOC))+
  geom_point(aes(y = CV, col = "CV"))+geom_point(aes(y=cv_fitted, col = "fitted"))+
  scale_color_viridis_d(end = 0.8)+
  theme_minimal()
```
